# GrantQuest

> GrantQuest is a scholarship hunt presented as an RPG quest log. Each
> scholarship is a quest with eligibility gates to clear, documents to gather,
> and a deadline countdown to beat.

## Key pages

- [Quest board](https://grantquest.tech/#board): all published scholarships.
- [How it works](https://grantquest.tech/#how): chart the quest, clear the gates, gather the documents, beat the deadline.
- [Quest log](https://grantquest.tech/log): the signed-in adventurer's record of started quests, states, and XP.
- [Sign in](https://grantquest.tech/login): one-time email code or Google, no passwords. Syncs the quest log across devices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://grantquest.tech/privacy): what is collected and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://grantquest.tech/terms): content honesty and acceptable use.

## Scholarship categories on the board

25 published quests spanning undergraduate, master's, PhD, and any-level study,
across Italy, Nauru, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Switzerland,
the United States, Brazil, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Bermuda, Hong Kong SAR,
Israel, China, and Sweden. Examples include Chevening (UK), DAAD EPOS (Germany),
Erasmus Mundus (EU), Fulbright (USA), and Rhodes (multiple regions).

## How quest data is verified

Quest data is verified to our best effort and flagged when it needs
re-verification. Always confirm deadlines and eligibility with the official
source before applying.

## Accounts and data

Exploring the board needs no account. An account stores only an email address
plus quest progress (states, cleared gates, gathered documents) and XP, to sync
across devices. Accounts and all data can be deleted in-app or by email.
